title: Polystack README Structured Logging Notes
goal: Add structured logging notes to polystack README only if useful

objectives.description: Inspect the polystack README and existing structured logging patterns to decide whether README notes would be useful.

tasks.description: Locate polystack README and any existing logging documentation; summarize current coverage of structured logging.
tasks.shard_input: Find the polystack README (and nearby docs). Report: (1) exact README path, (2) whether structured logging is already documented, (3) any logging setup/config/examples already present, (4) whether adding structured logging notes would be useful or redundant.

tasks.description: Scan polystack code for structured logging libraries, fields, and conventions to ground any README notes.
tasks.shard_input: Search polystack for structured logging usage (e.g. slog, zap, zerolog, logrus, JSON logs, logger interfaces). Summarize: library used, key fields/context patterns, how to enable/configure, and 1-3 concrete usage examples suitable for README notes. Conclude whether README notes would be useful.

phases.name: Add structured logging notes if useful

objectives.description: If research shows a gap, add concise structured logging notes to the polystack README only; otherwise leave the README unchanged.

tasks.description: If structured logging notes are useful and not already covered, update the polystack README with a short, accurate section; skip modification if redundant.
tasks.shard_input: Using research findings: ONLY if useful and not already documented, add a concise Structured Logging section to the polystack README covering library, key fields/context, enable/config notes, and a minimal example. Match existing README tone and structure. If notes would not be useful or already exist, make no file changes and report that decision.

tasks.description: Verify the README change is accurate, minimal, and only present when useful.
tasks.shard_input: Confirm either: (A) no README change was needed and none was made, or (B) the added structured logging notes are accurate, non-redundant, and scoped only to the polystack README.
